content: {"episode_id":"ep-05045","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) based on the documented clinical indication, acknowledging that prior authorization was missing. The patient has recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope in the setting of known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation. Given the intermittent symptoms and the need to correlate clinical events with arrhythmic activity, mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture rhythm data during daily activities."}
